method: Review 18 pending phrases in their original paragraph contexts and add three targeted discourse/structure entries. Reuse already reviewed Title IX and snippets cards rather than duplicate them or infer criminal findings.
phrases: go through
read or examine material carefully
仔细阅读；逐一查看
Let's go through the notes before the meeting.
开会前，我们逐一看一下笔记吧。
Different from Unit 4's experience-a-process sense. Source means examine snippets, not necessarily review the complete underlying investigation.
in possession of
having or holding something
持有；拥有
She was in possession of the original receipt.
她持有原始收据。
Formal possession phrase; holding an item does not by itself identify its source or establish all surrounding acts. Source expressly lists uncertain alternatives.
off campus
outside the university's campus grounds
在校外
Many students live off campus.
许多学生住在校外。
Use off-campus before a noun in edited writing. Source negates off campus and infers jurisdiction; location alone does not prove every legal or institutional power.
under the jurisdiction of
within the authority or responsibility of an institution or body
在……的管辖范围内
The notice says the facility is under the jurisdiction of the city.
通知称，该设施在市政府管辖范围内。
A formal authority phrase. This gloss does not verify the narrator's conclusion about Cornell's jurisdiction or eliminate possible overlapping authority.
we don't know if
we lack certainty about whether something is true
我们不知道是否……
We don't know if the two reports describe the same event.
我们不知道两份报告描述的是否是同一件事。
If means whether in an embedded question. Source's alternative accounts must remain alternatives, not a synthesized factual timeline.
in the chapter house
inside the premises used by a local fraternity or sorority group
在分会会所里
The members held a meeting in the chapter house.
成员们在分会会所里开了会。
Chapter is a local organizational branch, not a book section. Source pairs this with on the road as a rhetorical wherever-members-are contrast.
for about two years
for approximately a two-year duration
大约两年
She has worked here for about two years.
她在这里工作了大约两年。
For introduces duration, about makes it approximate, and has been there in source connects it to the narrated point rather than today's date.
get into all of it
discuss all the material just mentioned in more detail
详细谈谈刚才提到的全部内容
We'll get into all of it after a short overview.
简要概述之后，我们会详细谈到这些内容。
Discuss sense, not physically enter. All of it refers to the announced material, not every possible fact about the case.
safe environment
a setting regarded as protected from harm or danger
安全的环境
The organizers want to provide a safe environment for discussion.
组织者希望提供一个安全的讨论环境。
Source says seems like and made it seem like, describing an impression; do not turn it into a guarantee of safety.
sue not just
bring legal action against one named party and additional parties
起诉的不只是……
In the fictional example, they sue not just the seller but also the distributor.
在这个虚构例子中，他们起诉的不只是卖家，还有经销商。
Incomplete not just A but B frame; preserve the list structure. Naming defendants does not establish their liability.
what was going on
what was happening at the relevant time
当时发生了什么；当时是什么情况
I asked a colleague what was going on.
我问同事当时是什么情况。
Embedded question uses statement word order. Source discusses awareness, not an independent account of every event.
sort of like
an informal hedge or approximate comparison
有点像；大概算是（口语弱化表达）
The workshop felt sort of like a group problem-solving session.
那次工作坊感觉有点像一次集体解决问题的讨论。
Source combines some sort of with filler like before interim suspension; do not force the whole sequence into a clean comparison or formal written model.
interim suspension
a temporary suspension while a further decision or process is pending
临时停权或停学；等待后续决定期间的暂停资格
The notice describes the suspension as an interim measure.
通知将此次暂停资格描述为临时措施。
Interim is pending further action, not necessarily a final punishment. Specific institutional powers or findings are not established by the term alone.
made an arrest
took someone into custody under legal authority
实施了逮捕
The report says officers made an arrest later that day.
报告称，警员在当天晚些时候实施了逮捕。
Make an arrest is a common collocation; arrest is not conviction. Source is an imagined paraphrase addressed to the house, not a newly verified police quotation.
personal integrity
honesty and consistency in following one's moral principles
个人操守；正直的品格
The role requires sound judgment and personal integrity.
这个职位要求良好的判断力和正直的品格。
Integrity concerns ethical character here, not technical data integrity. Source quotes stated values without proving adherence to them.
breaks open
becomes widely exposed or develops dramatically
被揭开；出现重大进展
The fictional case breaks open when a new witness comes forward.
在这个虚构案件中，一名新证人出面后，案情有了重大进展。
Figurative opening of a case to public attention or new information; not necessarily solved, adjudicated or physically broken.
relevant details
information directly connected to the topic being discussed
相关细节
Please include only the relevant details in the summary.
请只在摘要中写入相关细节。
Relevant means pertinent, not automatically true or complete. Source attributes details to a plaintiff's account.
make so many friends
form friendships with a large number of people
交到很多朋友
She didn't expect to make so many friends in the class.
她没想到能在班里交到这么多朋友。
Make friends with someone, not manufacture friends. Source reports a promised social benefit rather than guaranteeing it.
in a second
very soon, in informal speech
马上；一会儿
I'll explain the changes in a second.
我马上解释这些改动。
Usually not literally one second. In the source get into means discuss, and the phrase previews the topic rather than specifying an audio timestamp.
not supposed to
not permitted or not expected to do something under a rule or norm
按规定不应该；不允许
You're not supposed to leave boxes in the hallway.
按规定，你不应该把箱子放在走廊里。
Rule/expectation, not physical inability. Source is a paraphrased institutional reaction, not a complete statement of drug law.
whether on the road or in the chapter house
in either of the two settings named
无论在外途中还是在分会会所里
Whether on the road or at home, she keeps in touch with friends.
无论在旅途中还是在家，她都和朋友保持联系。
Whether A or B covers alternatives. The teaching example changes the second location explicitly; source's hand-of-brotherhood metaphor still needs separate support.
segments: Reviewing excerpts, the institutional framework and the preview expression are all linked. The which-clause identifies the investigation, and there are allegations prevents overdose being treated as a proven event.
The rule-based prohibition meaning is explicitly taught; hey and it's like frame an imagined reaction rather than a verbatim policy quotation.

The existing sourced Title IX definition supplies the institutional context; national news adds countrywide reach to the reviewed make-the-news idiom. The narrator's claim of no such coverage is not independently verified.
